description: Canonical index for appendable county/story/sense phrase-family authoring. Counts are computed, never used as coverage claims.

emergency_harvest.objective: Capture broad provisional county/story phrase-family material before the ElevenLabs subscription expires; wastage and rework are accepted.

capacity_policy.above_capture_maximum_requires: During D32, additional provisional utterances may be captured when they carry stable identity, provenance, risk metadata, and a plausible county/story/learning use. After D32, the normal cap and documented-use rule resume.
irish_priority_order: controlled listening contrasts required by a defined learning action

reserves.configuration_experiments: bounded and only within a separately user-approved amendment to the locked configuration
reserves.speaking_clearly: bounded minority of remaining prepaid credits; separate project and separate contract records

invariants: Capture inventory and learner-release inventory are separate.
Volume never permits unstructured, unsupported, or provenance-free text.
Unreviewed capture is not learner-release approval.

irish_generation_lock.deviation_policy: A batch may not override this profile. Any deviation requires a new explicit user decision and a versioned contract change before a manifest can validate.
